title: Tooling: preserve complete replay selection in sparse checkouts
body:
## Change and scope

Complete registered replay discovery in sparse checkouts. At this base, HEAD has **1,244** registered manifests, but the contributor's sparse checkout materializes only **18**. The old filesystem-only global-trigger plan therefore silently omitted 1,226 declarations. The updated planner includes all 1,244 in the same sorted, unique matrix order without materializing their packages.

Fallback is allowed only for an absent regular manifest whose stage-zero skip-worktree index entry matches HEAD's exact mode and blob. Ordinary/staged deletion, changed index contents or mode, conflicts, symlink manifests and unreadable inventory still fail. Working edits/new local manifests remain visible; committed opt-in removals remain valid. The omitted count is reported on stderr. This is dependency routing, not mathematical replay or permission to execute absent code. Materialize packages and inputs before replay.

## Task and overlap

Base `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, refreshed at selection and publication. Verification engineering, session seed 87; scoped coverage repair. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200#discussioncomment-18991844). Latest overlap refresh covered 266 open PRs and 1,896 discussion records with complete reported pagination; live issues and hub comments were also refreshed.

Arham-Tahir64's PR3102 (`39bb449ef136cb3899ca16a6933abba52decf021`) chooser already uses the stricter HEAD/index sparse-reference premise; this applies it to replay manifests. PR3140 explains selection and touches the same planning loop. The two features are independent, but integrating both requires retaining its reason records while iterating this manifest provider; a local prospective integration passed both features' 16 regression tests. Neither PR is a prerequisite for this standalone fix.

## Validation

`python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_sparse_planning.py' -v`

Ten real-Git controls cover full/sparse equality, entirely omitted research directories, changed inputs/global triggers, prefix-name ordering, ordinary/staged/committed deletion, changed skip-worktree blobs and modes, conflicted index entries, invalid hidden JSON/inputs, local edits/new declarations and non-regular HEAD manifests. The full Python 3.12.14 research-tool suite passes **232 tests, 11 platform skips**. Combined PR3140/sparse controls pass **16 tests** on Python 3.14.7.

The actual `--changed-since 0` run returns all **1,244 sorted unique packages**, reporting **1,226** sparse manifests. The initial full-suite run caught a prefix-name ordering regression; the fixed version and new control pass. Missing manifest blobs in this partial clone were fetched in one batch of 1,238 unique pinned objects for the repository check; no source packages or frozen artifacts were regenerated. Partial clones may otherwise incur Git's ordinary lazy fetches. No mathematical replays were run locally; hosted CI is separate.

## Credit and next questions

Tekalign, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Credits the retained planner, exact Git spelling, symlink and inventory-error controls, and Arham-Tahir64's sparse-reference contract in PR3102. See the package guide's sparse-planning section. Actual sparse replay still requires its code and dependencies; automatic transitive materialization remains outside this change.
